title: Zang International with Lynette Zang: 401(k)s and Gold: Lynette Zang Questions Who
description:
Original video author: Zang International with Lynette Zang. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Lynette Zang questions whether 401(k)s and other financial accounts give savers meaningful control over their wealth. This recap credits Zang International with Lynette Zang and follows her discussion of high earners seeking flexibility, Ireland’s savings proposal and proposed annual 1% tax above €50,000, and Mexican pension funds’ government-debt holdings. We cover her Social Security comparison, inflation concerns, and argument for personally held gold and silver. Zang also promotes her firm’s services.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
